_doc: SIMCODE v2 network sets for the paper simulations (analysis/papersim/run_simcode.py --netset <name>). Paths relative to the models dir. cal_sim / p2_cal_sim = the simulation sigma calibrations (no real-data mismatch multiplier); cal_real / p2_cal_real = the ones the production runs on the real movies used (--cal_kind real). sig_u = the selection-aware sigma rescale per pass (as the production strict step). Which set the paper uses is NOT decided (user, 2026-11-11).

default._doc: current production default (simcode2/config.py; the 1809_2 production nets)
default.head: hd_sc5nb.pt

m1809._doc: PSF-matched 1809 set (trained on the averaged 1809/2 PSF; adopted by the user 2026-11-11 20:50; production out/paper2/1809_2/v2_matched)
m1809.head: hd_m1809.pt

g13._doc: PSF-matched set for the Gaussian sigma 1.3 px PSF (preprint-condition simulations; models/insitu/calib_gauss1.3.json; m1809 recipe + --dens 0.0005,0.06, --tau 3,80; 2026-11-12)
g13.head: hd_g13.pt
